bullets.text: Pornhub Uses Apple Verification - **Pornhub** adopts **Apple's** age verification for UK users to comply with new legislation.
Premier League Streaming - Watch **West Ham** vs. **Arsenal** live on **USA Network** this Sunday.
Cybersecurity Executive Fined - Former **L3Harris** executive ordered to pay $10M for selling hacking tools to a Russian broker.
Google Celebrates Attenborough - **Google Search** features an Easter egg for **Sir David Attenborough's** 100th birthday.
ChatGPT's Safety Feature - **OpenAI** introduces a Trusted Contact feature for users discussing self-harm.
Oppo Find X9 Ultra Review - The **Oppo Find X9 Ultra** raises the bar for smartphone cameras.
New Apple TV Rumors - Upcoming **Apple TV 4K** may incorporate AI features inspired by **Netflix**.
GM Settles Privacy Case - **General Motors** agrees to pay $12.75M over driver data privacy violations.
Nvidia's AI Investments - **Nvidia** commits $40B to AI equity deals, including a significant investment in **OpenAI**.
New Google Travel Features - **Google** launches new tools for tracking hotel prices just in time for summer.
